ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio; fluke surface is predominantly composed of low-intensity black pixels (intensity < 40) with sparse high-intensity white focal points (intensity > 210) occupying less than 12% of the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary substrate is contiguous black; high-contrast white mottling and focal spots are concentrated at the distal lobe tips and sporadically along the trailing edge margin; right lobe exhibits a higher density of white pixel clusters compared to the left.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 42 degrees; the vertex is well-defined despite partial water occlusion at the base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated topography along the entire trailing edge; peak-to-valley amplitude varies from 4 to 18 pixels; serrations are more pronounced and closely spaced on the segments proximal to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Mathematical sweep exhibits initial concavity starting from the median notch, transitioning into a convex curve as the lobes extend toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; clusters contain between 5 and 15 individual circular units.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of several parallel, high-contrast linear disruptions (rake marks) on the mid-right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization on distal tips and distinct parallel linear scars (rake marks) visible on the right lobe surface.
